Title: MEMBERSHIP : Annual
Description:
Cultivate Inner Peace and Unleash Your Inner Warrior: Join the school of Chin Family – Zhong Xin Dao / I Liq Chuan!

Ready to deepen your practice and unlock the full potential of I Liq Chuan? Become a member of the Chin Family I Liq Chuan Association and embark on a rewarding journey of self-discovery and growth.

Here’s what awaits you:

  • Master the Art: Progress through the I Liq Chuan ranking system, a testament to your dedication and skill.

  • Become an Instructor (Optional): Earn your certification and share your passion by building your own I Liq Chuan classes.

  • Travel and Train: Enjoy exclusive discounts on I Liq Chuan workshops held around the world, connect with fellow practitioners, and learn from renowned instructors.

  • Local Perks: Many regional instructors offer additional benefits to their students. Find an instructor near you and explore the possibilities!

Membership Options to Suit Your Needs:

  • Regular Membership: Train at a discounted rate.

  • 21 & Under Membership: Special discounts for ages 21 and under

  • Senior Membership (65+): Enjoy a special discounted rate.

  • Lifetime Membership: Pay once and benefit for a lifetime!

Join our growing community and invest in your mindful journey with I Liq Chuan today!

*Membership will auto renew until cancel.

Title: LICENSE : School (YEARLY)
Description:
School License

This license grants the permission to establish and operate an I Liq Chuan school, certify students and offer a variety of programs. Note that every school requires a certified instructor to lead classes; this may be the owner of the school, but a school owner may also employ other instructors.

Title: VIDEO : Class Video Library
Description:
A curated collection of training resources that we regularly update. The library contains recordings from our weekly online classes and add special highlights from our live workshops throughout the year. It’s a great way to catch up on what you missed or dive deeper into specific training at your own pace.

Log into the Members Portal to gain access.
